Your holdings: SMCI (-19.59%), METU (-16.98%), MUU (-24.44%), SOXL (-54.59%), and SPAL (-40.76%) are all marked SELL and are deep in the red. Given your margin concentration, these are the most concerning.

Watch: The PCE inflation data and any Fed commentary. Also, keep an eye on Alphabet's AI impact on search.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged and tech positions in this inflationary environment.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL if they show further weakness; these leveraged ETFs decay and are bleeding you.
Consider trimming SMCI, METU, and MUU if they don't show immediate signs of recovery.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
